title: I Built a Tower
can_do: 讲今天和同伴做的一件事，在一次具体追问后补充小意外与结果。
trigger: Rabbit Teacher invites Child to share one thing he did today, then asks whether the tower he mentions stayed up.
core_response: I built a tower with Maya.
setting: A quiet end-of-day classroom conversation with Rabbit Teacher and Child seated facing each other.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: Tell me one thing you did today.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I built a tower with Maya.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: Thanks for telling me about your tower.

replay_cards.title: The picture from today
replay_cards.setting: A quiet chat with Dad after drawing at home
replay_cards.change: Dad recognizes the picture but thinks Child made it yesterday
replay_cards.challenge: Child tells Dad he made a picture today. Dad asks whose picture has a sun, and Child answers, "It's mine. It has a sun." Dad recalls it as yesterday's picture. Child clarifies, "No, that was today." Dad accepts the correction and acknowledges what Child made. Stay with this one drawing event; the picture can be remembered rather than fetched.

replay_cards.title: Joining Maya's game
replay_cards.change: Mom is interested in how Child joined the game he mentions
replay_cards.challenge: Child says, "Today I played with Maya." Mom asks how he joined. Child recalls his request: "I asked, 'Can I play with you?'" He adds that Maya said yes and they played together. Mom acknowledges the complete event. Maya stays a person in Child's memory; no one acts or speaks as a third character.

parent_support: Invite one recent event he wants to share. Accept a short answer and use the tower's outcome as one concrete follow-up; do not ask him to report the whole day.

After hearing that the tower fell, acknowledge it and wait for his next thought. Building, falling and rebuilding belong to one small play episode; he need not produce a first/then list or retell it perfectly.
Listen with calm interest. A small hand gesture or nod can support the memory without reenacting it. Acknowledge the event he told, not the quality of his English.
